failure_summary.description: Search calls were left unsaved, or duplicate result-producing calls were made, despite the required assign-and-save workflow.
Follow-ups omitted a new constraint, searched instead of filtering a suitable cached result, or failed to retrieve and use the latest cache entry.
A state abbreviation was passed as a city, or a named landmark was incorrectly used as a neighborhood instead of as a proximity anchor.
Agents added unrelated work or Python date handling where direct tool calls and established itinerary values were sufficient.

patch.reasoning: These failures are already directly covered by the skill: it requires assigning and saving every result, updating suitable cached results with all new same-domain constraints, mapping states and neighborhoods correctly, using proximity tools for landmark requests, and avoiding imports or unrelated operations. Adding more text would duplicate existing guidance rather than address a skill gap.
